title: Homology evaluation is perfect on locally split finite free models
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let T and J be integer-indexed cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let n be an integer. Assume H^k(J)=0 for every k different from zero. Write P=Hom^bullet(T,J) [def-pur-hom-complex]. There is a unique morphism e:H^n(P) to Hom(H^(-n)(T),H^0(J)) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] satisfying both the following properties. First, for every open U, Hom cocycle phi over U, T-cycle z of degree -n over U, and J-cycle b of degree zero over U whose inclusion equals the evaluation of the (-n,0) component of phi on the inclusion of z, e([phi])([z])=[b]. Second, for every open V of X and open W of V, let F be restriction to V followed by restriction to its over site W [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], applied termwise to complexes. If F(J) is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex] and F(T) admits a quasi-isomorphism roof [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] L to F(T), L to E, where all differentials of E vanish, E is zero outside some finite integer interval, and every E^k is isomorphic to a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf, then F(e) is an isomorphism. The component projection and evaluation in the first property are those of the fixed Hom-complex bifunctor.

proof.text: Obtain a cycle-evaluation morphism e by the existence lemma; equip it with local perfection by the local-isomorphism lemma. For any other e' satisfying both properties, use only its cycle formula and the uniqueness lemma to deduce e'=e. This is the Lean ExistsUnique introduction proof.

theorem exists_homologyEvaluation (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (T J : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) (n : ℤ)
    (hJ : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → IsZero (J.homology k)) :
    ∃! e : (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) T J).homology n ⟶
      SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) (T.homology (-n)) (J.homology 0),
      IsHomologyEvaluation X T J n e ∧
        ∀ (V : X.Opens) (W : V.toScheme.Opens),
          let Fc := moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor X V W
          CochainComplex.IsKInjective (Fc.obj J) →
          HasFiniteFreeZeroModel (V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over W) (Fc.obj T) →
          IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map e).over W)
